critic.notes: Re-read p0/a1/p50/p100 at 960x540. Decision tree (p50) and B+ tree (p100) read without narration: lit cyan route with pulse beads, crit/ok glyph chips, green search hit, dashed leaf chain; Arabic and mixed AR+Latin correct, RTL branch order right (yes branch on the right). Tokens only (no raw hex/rgba in TreeView.tsx). No blocking issue.
